summary: Feed s058_single is degraded: 5.2% packet drops (147/2843 TCP packets, threshold 1%) detected. All other checks (duplicates, encrypted_share, missing_vlan, one_way, tool_overload) are healthy, so NDR directionality, VLANs and capacity are OK but loss impairs detection.

findings.root_cause: Upstream SPAN/mirror or packet broker buffer oversubscription is dropping packets before the NDR. 5.17% TCP gaps with tool_overload healthy indicates loss in the visibility fabric (SPAN port congestion/broker egress drop), not NDR overload. SPAN copies are best-effort and drop under load.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires both directions and full payload for TCP reassembly and threat detection. 5.2% missing segments breaks stream reassembly, causes incomplete flows, missed signatures/anomalies and significantly reduced detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Hardware TAP provides lossless line-rate copy unlike SPAN which drops when buffers oversubscribe. Replacing SPAN with TAP (and ensuring packet broker has sufficient buffer/bandwidth) eliminates the 5%+ loss and restores complete traffic to the NDR.
